title: Updated GUI by KLimmer136
description: Revamps hearts, armor, and bubbles with an aesthetic touch. Includes a custom iron sword attack indicator and a sleek hotbar and a loooooot more.
body:
✨ Aesthetic UI & Icons
This resource pack focuses on refining the vanilla Minecraft interface. It revamps the core survival elements to give them a more polished and "aesthetic" look without losing the classic feel.

💖 Key Features:
Redesigned Hearts: Smoother, more beautiful health icons for a cleaner look.

Updated HUD: Fresh new textures for the Armor bar, Air bubbles, and the Hotbar.

Enhanced GUI: A sleek, modern take on the primary survival interface.

🛠 Small Tweaks:
I’ve also included some "quality of life" visual changes, such as:

Custom Attack Indicator: The critical hit/recharge icon near the hotbar has been replaced with a sleek Iron Sword icon.
